mxCell.value: Storage model: In-memory state + external aggregation. Risk scores computed dynamically from: - Account service (transaction history) - Fraud service (fraud scores) - Credit engine outputs No dedicated PostgreSQL tables — events persisted to Lakehouse via Kafka.

CreditRiskProfile (computed) ---------------------- entity_id (varchar) entity_type (varchar: customer/business) tenant_id (varchar) credit_score (int) pd (float: probability of default) lgd (float: loss given default) ead (float: exposure at default) risk_grade (varchar: A/B/C/D/E) credit_limit (int64) outstanding_exposure (int64) collateral_value (int64) last_assessed_at (timestamp)

MarketRiskPosition (computed) ---------------------- position_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) asset_type (varchar: fx/equity/bond/commodity) currency / asset_id (varchar) notional_value / market_value (int64) var_1d / var_10d (float: Value at Risk) sensitivity (float: delta/gamma/vega) stress_loss (int64) limit / utilization (float) status (varchar) updated_at

OperationalRiskEvent (computed) ---------------------- event_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) event_type (varchar: fraud/system_failure/human_error) category (varchar: people/process/technology/external) severity (varchar) actual_loss / potential_loss (int64) description (text) root_cause / mitigation (text) status (varchar: open/mitigated/closed) occurred_at / reported_at

RiskLimit (computed) ---------------------- limit_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) limit_type (varchar: credit/market/operational/liquidity) entity_type / entity_id (varchar) limit_value (int64) current_utilization (int64) utilization_pct (float) warning_threshold / breach_threshold (float) status (varchar: normal/warning/breached) updated_at
